name: [Negative] App Functionality Issues and Disappointments
description: Users are experiencing various bugs, feature removals, and performance issues that are leading to frustration and disappointment. Key concerns include the loss of order history, inability to filter orders, and problems with equity and P&L calculations.

name: [Negative] UI/UX and Order Placement Issues
description: Users report that recent app updates have introduced a confusing interface, critical bugs in order placement, and loss of real‑time data, leading to incorrect trade execution and frustration.
